s00-01-grave-22ea9a.wav.text: In front of them, the sea.

s00-02-grave-7df747.wav.text: Behind them, six hundred chariots. And nowhere left to run.

s00-03-talk-d63acf.wav.text: Most people remember this story as Moses parting the sea with his staff, like a hero in a film.

s00-04-pivot-3eb04f.wav.text: But read it closely, and Moses isn't the hero.

s01-01-story-07a911.wav.text: When Pharaoh finally let them go, there was a short road out of Egypt.

s01-02-story-d7f149.wav.text: It ran straight along the coast.

s01-04-talk-24bc80.wav.text: The short road was full of soldiers.

s01-06-story-7b02d2.wav.text: One battle, and they'd run straight back to slavery.

s01-07-grave-0dab92.wav.text: Lest the people change their minds when they see war and return to Egypt.

s02-02-grave-3c4354.wav.text: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead them along the way,

s02-03-grave-5ec843.wav.text: and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, that they might travel by day and by night.

s02-04-story-aaab18.wav.text: Then God told Moses something strange.

s02-05-story-c9417f.wav.text: Turn back, and camp by the sea.

s03-02-story-de4a3d.wav.text: His slaves were gone. His brick fields were empty.

s03-03-story-9bbe97.wav.text: And his officials asked the question he was already thinking.

s03-04-grave-a62589.wav.text: What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

s03-05-story-e360e5.wav.text: So Pharaoh took six hundred of his best chariots, and every other chariot in Egypt, and went after them.

s04-01-story-db4c34.wav.text: Israel looked up and saw the army coming.

s04-02-story-340603.wav.text: And they were terrified. They turned on Moses.

s04-03-grave-353196.wav.text: Is it because there are no graves in Egypt that you have taken us away to die in the wilderness?

s05-01-pivot-262aba.wav.text: Moses answered with the strangest battle plan in history.

s05-02-grave-6479e5.wav.text: Fear not, stand firm, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today.

s05-03-grave-d4bda7.wav.text: The LORD will fight for you, and you have only to be silent.

s05-06-story-2f6886.wav.text: Then God told Moses to stop crying out, and to tell the people to go forward.

s06-02-story-19c147.wav.text: It went behind Israel and stood between the two armies.

s06-03-story-492acc.wav.text: Darkness on one side, light on the other.

s06-04-grave-901ea4.wav.text: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea,

s06-05-grave-746b98.wav.text: and the LORD drove the sea back by a strong east wind all night and made the sea dry land,

s07-02-grave-5e0bc1.wav.text: And the people of Israel went into the midst of the sea on dry ground,

s07-03-grave-bb8d3e.wav.text: the waters being a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

s07-04-story-1d08f2.wav.text: Through the night they crossed, on the floor of the sea.

s08-02-story-ac9bc6.wav.text: Then their chariot wheels began to stick.

s08-04-grave-4125dc.wav.text: Let us flee from before Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians.

s08-06-grave-5fd745.wav.text: Moses stretched out his hand, and the sea came back.

s08-07-story-6ea5b4.wav.text: By sunrise, Pharaoh's army was gone.

s09-01-story-0b1ced.wav.text: On the other shore, Moses' sister Miriam took a tambourine, and all the women danced with her.

s09-02-grave-4ada44.wav.text: Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider he has thrown into the sea.

s09-04-story-db59d4.wav.text: Not Moses. Not themselves. The LORD.

s10-02-story-3d2326.wav.text: The LORD will fight for you.

s10-04-story-7f57a7.wav.text: Ahead lay a desert with no bread and no water.

s10-05-story-713abe.wav.text: And a mountain, where God would speak.
